sources.title: Tail fitting for truncated and non-truncated Pareto-type distributions
sources.snippet: Recently some papers, such as Aban, Meerschaert and Panorska (2006), Nuyts (2010) and Clark (2013), have drawn attention to possible truncation in Pareto tail modelling. Sometimes natural upper bounds exist that truncate the probability tail, such as the Maximum Possible Loss in insurance treaties. At other instances ultimately at the largest data, deviations from a Pareto tail behaviour become apparent. This matter is especially important when extrapolation outside the sample is required.
